report_title: Unified Google Lighthouse & axe-core Accessibility & Usability Evaluation
deduplication_rule: Issues flagged by both Lighthouse and axe-core counted strictly once

issue_register.user_impact: Screen reader and keyboard assistive technologies lacked document language detection, main landmark skip navigation, primary heading orientation, and logo alt identification.
issue_register.proposed_fix: Durably patched pretixcontrol/auth/base.html and pretixcontrol/auth/login.html to serve lang='en', <header role='banner'>, <main role='main' id='main-content'>, <h1 class='sr-only'>, alt='pretix official logo', and <meta name='description'> directly from Django templates.

issue_register.element: , keyboard :focus-visible outline, and meta description
issue_register.user_impact: Low-vision attendees and keyboard navigators experienced reduced contrast on muted metadata and subtle focus rings against light Bootstrap panel surfaces.
issue_register.proposed_fix: Durably injected server-rendered <style id='sqe-a11y-contrast-patch'> (.text-muted #4a4a4a, :focus-visible 3px solid #ff9900) and <meta name='description'> into pretixpresale/base.html.
issue_register.remediation_status: REMEDIATED (Storefront axe violations: 0; Lighthouse A11y: 100, SEO: 100)

issue_register.user_impact: Mobile touchscreen users benefit from >=44x44px hit areas on quantity steppers.
issue_register.proposed_fix: Recommend min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px in mobile responsive CSS media queries.

before_after_comparison.defect_addressed: Missing lang, landmarks, h1, meta description, and logo alt (WCAG 1.1.1 / 1.3.1 / 3.1.1)

before_remediation.element_state: Unpatched pretix auth template (no lang='en', no <main>, no <h1>, no meta description)
before_remediation.screen_reader_announcement: No language/landmark/h1 navigation; Graphic URL announced without context

after_remediation.element_state: Durably patched auth/base.html + auth/login.html (lang='en', <main>, <h1>, alt='pretix official logo')
after_remediation.screen_reader_announcement: English document, Banner, Main landmark, H1 Log in heading, pretix official logo image

before_after_comparison.verdict: 100% RESOLVED (4 -> 0 axe violations; Lighthouse A11y 69 -> 100, +31 pts)
